name: io.github.Servosity/hubspot-mcp
title: HubSpot MCP
description: Every HubSpot Sales Hub feature, plus offline cross-object queries, property-change-history

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN credential for the HubSpot MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the HubSpot API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_OWNER_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email address that `--owner me` resolves to when git config user.email is not set. Leave blank to name the owner on each call.

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required by `hubspot-mcp --transport http`; unused by the default stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on HubSpot requests.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
